##### Project general facts

The Beach Residences is a harmonious blend of contemporary design and beachfront serenity. This architectural masterpiece features striking facades that frame expansive, floor-to-ceiling windows, inviting the warmth and glow of natural light into every corner of your home. Offering a refined collection of residences, the development presents not just a home but also a promising investment opportunity in an area witnessing significant growth and development.

Residents enjoy a refined collection of hotel-like amenities for an enhanced living experience, including outdoor movies at twin cinemas, a specialized event area, and a BBQ space. Active lifestyles are catered to with an agility area, tennis and paddle courts, and a serene yoga lawn. Family-friendly features include a kids' pool, a majestic infinity pool with a pool bar, an outdoor gym, and a playful kids' area, all designed for luxurious comfort.

Every residence at The Beach Residences boasts interiors adorned with custom, high-quality finishes, elegant designer lighting, and cutting-edge appliances, ensuring both aesthetic appeal and practical functionality. The thoughtful design and premium materials create homes that are both beautiful and functional, offering a sanctuary of coastal elegance.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Marjan Island, a stunning man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, this exceptional location is one of the region's most prominent tourist destinations. Known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments, the island is shaped like a coral reef with primary islands connected by a central boulevard, offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf.

The location is distinguished by its pristine white sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters, providing an ideal setting for sunbathing, swimming, and water sports. The island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts with world-class amenities, private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options. A hub for entertainment and leisure activities, the island hosts various events and festivals throughout the year, and features dedicated areas for outdoor fitness and jogging tracks.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, world-class amenities, and a prime Ras Al Khaimah address, Al Marjan Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, luxurious offerings, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of seaside living.
